<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="hu">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=devicewidth, initialscale=1.0">
    <title>Jade  Intelligens Kutatási Platform</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Jade  Fejlett AI kutatási platform több modell együttműködésével">
    <meta name="themecolor" content="FF1493">
    <link rel="manifest" href="data:application/json;base64,eyJuYW1lIjoiSmFkZSIsInNob3J0X25hbWUiOiJKYWRlIiwic3RhcnRfdXJsIjoiLyIsImRpc3BsYXkiOiJzdGFuZGFsb25lIiwiYmFja2dyb3VuZF9jb2xvciI6IiMwMDAwMDAiLCJ0aGVtZV9jb2xvciI6IiNGRjE0OTMifQ==">
    <style>
        @import url('');
        
         {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            boxsizing: borderbox;
        }

        :root {
            bgprimary: 000000;
            bgsecondary: 1a0a14;
            bgtertiary: 2d1424;
            textprimary: ffffff;
            textsecondary: ffb6d9;
            texttertiary: d4a5c0;
            accent: FF1493;
            accenthover: FF69B4;
            gold: FFD700;
            goldlight: FFF4CC;
            bluelight: 87CEEB;
            pinklight: FFB6C1;
            success: FFD700;
            glassbg: rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15);
            border: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.4);
        }

        body {
            fontfamily: 'Montserrat', applesystem, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sansserif;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, 000000 0%, 1a0514 50%, 0a0a14 100%);
            color: var(textprimary);
            overflowx: hidden;
            webkitfontsmoothing: antialiased;
            mozosxfontsmoothing: grayscale;
        }

        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: radialgradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                        radialgradient(circle at 80% 50%, rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
            pointerevents: none;
            zindex: 0;
        }

        .hero {
            minheight: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            justifycontent: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 1000px;
            height: 1000px;
            background: radialgradient(circle, rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.25) 0%, rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.15) 50%, transparent 70%);
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(50%, 50%);
            animation: pulse 8s easeinout infinite;
        }

        .hero::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000"><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="2" fill="%23FFD700" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="300" cy="200" r="1.5" fill="%23FF69B4" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="500" cy="150" r="2" fill="%23FFD700" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="700" cy="250" r="1" fill="%2387CEEB" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="900" cy="100" r="2" fill="%23FF1493" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="150" cy="400" r="1.5" fill="%23FFD700" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="400" cy="500" r="2" fill="%23FF69B4" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="600" cy="450" r="1" fill="%2387CEEB" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="800" cy="550" r="2" fill="%23FFD700" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="200" cy="700" r="1.5" fill="%23FF1493" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="450" cy="800" r="2" fill="%23FFD700" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="650" cy="750" r="1" fill="%23FF69B4" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="850" cy="850" r="2" fill="%2387CEEB" opacity="0.5"/><circle cx="100" cy="900" r="1.5" fill="%23FFD700" opacity="0.6"/></svg>');
            backgroundsize: cover;
            animation: sparkle 3s linear infinite;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(50%, 50%) scale(1); opacity: 0.5; }
            50% { transform: translate(50%, 50%) scale(1.2); opacity: 0.8; }
        }

        @keyframes sparkle {
            0% { opacity: 0.3; }
            50% { opacity: 0.6; }
            100% { opacity: 0.3; }
        }

        .herocontent {
            textalign: center;
            zindex: 1;
            maxwidth: 900px;
            padding: 0 20px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .logo {
            fontsize: 72px;
            fontweight: 900;
            marginbottom: 24px;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493 0%, FFD700 50%, FF69B4 100%);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            textshadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.5);
            letterspacing: 2px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .logo::after {
            content: '✨';
            position: absolute;
            right: 40px;
            top: 10px;
            fontsize: 32px;
            animation: rotate 4s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .tagline {
            fontsize: 28px;
            fontweight: 600;
            background: lineargradient(90deg, FFD700, FF69B4, 87CEEB);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            marginbottom: 16px;
            lineheight: 1.4;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
        }

        .subtitle {
            fontsize: 17px;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            marginbottom: 48px;
            lineheight: 1.6;
        }

        .ctabutton {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493 0%, FF69B4 100%);
            color: white;
            border: 2px solid var(gold);
            padding: 16px 48px;
            fontsize: 17px;
            fontweight: 700;
            borderradius: 980px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubicbezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            boxshadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.6), 0 0 40px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .ctabutton::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: lineargradient(45deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), transparent);
            transform: rotate(45deg);
            animation: shine 3s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shine {
            0% { transform: translateX(100%) translateY(100%) rotate(45deg); }
            100% { transform: translateX(100%) translateY(100%) rotate(45deg); }
        }

        .ctabutton:hover {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF69B4 0%, FFB6C1 100%);
            transform: translateY(2px);
            boxshadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.8), 0 0 60px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5);
            bordercolor: var(goldlight);
        }

        .appcontainer {
            display: none;
            minheight: 100vh;
            flexdirection: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .appheader {
            background: rgba(26, 10, 20, 0.9);
            backdropfilter: blur(20px);
            webkitbackdropfilter: blur(20px);
            borderbottom: 2px solid var(border);
            padding: 16px 24px;
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            justifycontent: spacebetween;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            zindex: 100;
            boxshadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        .applogo {
            fontsize: 24px;
            fontweight: 900;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493 0%, FFD700 50%, FF69B4 100%);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            letterspacing: 1px;
        }

        .modetoggle {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            background: var(bgtertiary);
            padding: 4px;
            borderradius: 20px;
            border: 1px solid var(border);
        }

        .modebtn {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border: none;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            fontsize: 13px;
            fontweight: 600;
            borderradius: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .modebtn.active {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493 0%, FF69B4 100%);
            color: white;
            boxshadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.5);
        }

        .maincontent {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            maxwidth: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 24px;
            gap: 24px;
            position: relative;
            zindex: 1;
        }

        .chatarea {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flexdirection: column;
            background: rgba(26, 10, 20, 0.6);
            borderradius: 24px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            boxshadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
            backdropfilter: blur(10px);
        }

        .messages {
            flex: 1;
            overflowy: auto;
            padding: 24px;
            display: flex;
            flexdirection: column;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .message {
            maxwidth: 85%;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s easeout;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .message.user {
            alignself: flexend;
        }

        .messagecontent {
            background: var(bgtertiary);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            borderradius: 20px;
            lineheight: 1.6;
            fontsize: 15px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .message.user .messagecontent {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493 0%, FF69B4 100%);
            color: white;
            border: 1px solid var(gold);
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.4);
        }

        .message.assistant .messagecontent {
            background: rgba(45, 20, 36, 0.8);
            border: 1px solid var(border);
        }

        .messagemeta {
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            gap: 8px;
            marginbottom: 8px;
            fontsize: 13px;
            color: var(gold);
            fontweight: 600;
        }

        .inputarea {
            padding: 24px;
            bordertop: 2px solid var(border);
            background: rgba(26, 10, 20, 0.6);
        }

        .inputwrapper {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .messageinput {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(bgtertiary);
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            borderradius: 20px;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            color: var(textprimary);
            fontsize: 15px;
            resize: none;
            maxheight: 120px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .messageinput:focus {
            outline: none;
            bordercolor: var(accent);
            boxshadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .sendbtn {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493 0%, FF69B4 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(gold);
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            borderradius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            justifycontent: center;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            flexshrink: 0;
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.4);
        }

        .sendbtn:hover {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF69B4 0%, FFB6C1 100%);
            transform: scale(1.05);
            boxshadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.6);
        }

        .sendbtn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: notallowed;
        }

        .sidebar {
            width: 320px;
            background: rgba(26, 10, 20, 0.6);
            borderradius: 24px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            padding: 24px;
            display: flex;
            flexdirection: column;
            gap: 24px;
            boxshadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
            backdropfilter: blur(10px);
        }

        .sidebarsection h3 {
            fontsize: 15px;
            fontweight: 700;
            color: var(gold);
            marginbottom: 12px;
            texttransform: uppercase;
            letterspacing: 1px;
        }

        .statcard {
            background: var(bgtertiary);
            padding: 16px;
            borderradius: 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
        }

        .statvalue {
            fontsize: 32px;
            fontweight: 900;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493, FFD700);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            marginbottom: 4px;
        }

        .statlabel {
            fontsize: 13px;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            fontweight: 600;
        }

        .sourceitem {
            background: var(bgtertiary);
            padding: 12px;
            borderradius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid var(border);
            marginbottom: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .sourceitem:hover {
            bordercolor: var(accent);
            transform: translateX(4px);
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        .sourcetitle {
            fontsize: 14px;
            fontweight: 600;
            marginbottom: 4px;
            color: var(pinklight);
            display: webkitbox;
            webkitlineclamp: 2;
            webkitboxorient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .sourceurl {
            fontsize: 12px;
            color: var(bluelight);
            textdecoration: none;
            display: block;
            overflow: hidden;
            textoverflow: ellipsis;
            whitespace: nowrap;
        }

        .loading {
            display: inlineflex;
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .loading span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493, FFD700);
            borderradius: 50%;
            animation: bounce 1.4s infinite easeinout both;
        }

        .loading span:nthchild(1) { animationdelay: 0.32s; }
        .loading span:nthchild(2) { animationdelay: 0.16s; }

        @keyframes bounce {
            0%, 80%, 100% { transform: scale(0); }
            40% { transform: scale(1); }
        }

        .researchwidget {
            background: rgba(45, 20, 36, 0.9);
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            borderradius: 16px;
            padding: 20px;
            margintop: 12px;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s easeout;
            boxshadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        .researchheader {
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            gap: 12px;
            marginbottom: 16px;
        }

        .researchspinner {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border: 3px solid var(border);
            bordertopcolor: var(accent);
            borderradius: 50%;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .researchtitle {
            fontsize: 15px;
            fontweight: 700;
            color: var(gold);
        }

        .researchphase {
            background: var(bgsecondary);
            padding: 12px;
            borderradius: 12px;
            marginbottom: 8px;
            borderleft: 3px solid var(accent);
            boxshadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
        }

        .phasename {
            fontsize: 13px;
            fontweight: 700;
            color: var(accent);
            marginbottom: 4px;
        }

        .phasedetail {
            fontsize: 12px;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            margintop: 4px;
        }

        .researchstats {
            display: grid;
            gridtemplatecolumns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
            margintop: 12px;
        }

        .statitem {
            background: var(bgsecondary);
            padding: 8px;
            borderradius: 8px;
            textalign: center;
            border: 1px solid var(border);
        }

        .statnumber {
            fontsize: 20px;
            fontweight: 900;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493, FFD700);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
        }

        .stattext {
            fontsize: 11px;
            color: var(texttertiary);
            margintop: 2px;
            fontweight: 600;
        }

        .progressbar {
            height: 4px;
            background: var(bgsecondary);
            borderradius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margintop: 12px;
        }

        .progressfill {
            height: 100%;
            background: lineargradient(90deg, FF1493, FFD700, FF69B4);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            boxshadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.6);
        }

        .researchbadge {
            display: inlineblock;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3), rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2));
            color: var(gold);
            borderradius: 12px;
            fontsize: 12px;
            fontweight: 700;
            marginleft: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(gold);
        }

        @media (maxwidth: 1024px) {
            .sidebar { display: none; }
            .maincontent { padding: 16px; }
        }

        @media (maxwidth: 640px) {
            .logo { fontsize: 48px; }
            .tagline { fontsize: 22px; }
            .subtitle { fontsize: 15px; }
            .maincontent { padding: 12px; }
            .chatarea { borderradius: 16px; }
        }

        .statusindicator {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(gold);
            borderradius: 50%;
            display: inlineblock;
            marginright: 8px;
            animation: pulsedot 2s infinite;
            boxshadow: 0 0 10px var(gold);
        }

        @keyframes pulsedot {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; }
        }

        .researchlog {
            fontsize: 12px;
            color: var(texttertiary);
            margintop: 8px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: var(bgprimary);
            borderradius: 8px;
            maxheight: 200px;
            overflowy: auto;
            border: 1px solid var(border);
        }

        .researchlogitem {
            padding: 4px 0;
            borderbottom: 1px solid var(border);
        }

        .researchlogitem:lastchild {
            borderbottom: none;
        }

        .reportsection {
            margintop: 16px;
            padding: 16px;
            background: var(bgprimary);
            borderradius: 12px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
        }

        .reportsection h1, .reportsection h2, .reportsection h3 {
            margintop: 1em;
            marginbottom: 0.5em;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FF1493, FFD700);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
        }

        .reportsection h1 { fontsize: 24px; }
        .reportsection h2 { fontsize: 20px; }
        .reportsection h3 { fontsize: 18px; }

        .reportsection strong {
            color: var(pinklight);
        }

        .reportsection sup {
            color: var(gold);
            fontweight: 700;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="hero" id="hero">
        <div class="herocontent">
            <div class="logo">Jade</div>
            <div class="tagline">Intelligencia Határokon Túl</div>
            <div class="subtitle">
                Használd ki a kollaboratív AI erejét hogy több ezer forrásból kutass, elemezz és szintetizálj információkat. 
                Jade nem csak keres—gondolkodik, értékel és felfedez. Akár órákig kutathat autonomikusan és 2030 oldalas jelentést készít.
            </div>
            <button class="ctabutton" onclick="startApp()">Kutatás Indítása</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="appcontainer" id="app">
        <div class="appheader">
            <div class="applogo">Jade</div>
            <div class="modetoggle">
                <button class="modebtn active" datamode="chat">Chat</button>
                <button class="modebtn" datamode="research">Kutatás</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="maincontent">
            <div class="chatarea">
                <div class="messages" id="messages"></div>
                <div class="inputarea">
                    <div class="inputwrapper">
                        <textarea 
                            class="messageinput" 
                            id="messageInput" 
                            placeholder="Kérdezz bármit vagy indíts mély kutatást..."
                            rows="1"
                        ></textarea>
                        <button class="sendbtn" id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">
                            <svg width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokewidth="2">
                                <path d="M22 2L11 13M22 2l7 204994 207z" stroke="white"/>
                            </svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sidebar">
                <div class="sidebarsection">
                    <h3>Státusz</h3>
                    <div class="statcard">
                        <div class="statvalue" id="sourceCount">0</div>
                        <div class="statlabel">Elemzett Forrás</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebarsection">
                    <h3>Friss Források</h3>
                    <div id="sourcesList"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebarsection">
                    <h3>Rendszer</h3>
                    <div class="statcard">
                        <div style="display: flex; alignitems: center; fontsize: 14px;">
                            <span class="statusindicator"></span>
                            <span>Minden Rendszer Működik</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        let currentMode = 'chat';
        let isProcessing = false;

        function startApp() {
            document.getElementById('hero').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'flex';
            addMessage('assistant', 'Üdvözlöm a Jadeben! Segíthetek gyors kérdésekben vagy mélyreható kutatást végezhetek több ezer forrásból. Akár órákig kutathatok és részletes jelentést készítek. Miben segíthetek?');
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.modebtn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.modebtn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                btn.classList.add('active');
                currentMode = btn.dataset.mode;
                
                const placeholder = currentMode === 'research' 
                    ? 'Írja be a kutatási kérdést mélyreható elemzéshez (akár 2030 oldalas jelentés)...'
                    : 'Kérdezz bármit vagy indíts mély kutatást...';
                document.getElementById('messageInput').placeholder = placeholder;
            });
        });

        const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
        messageInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
        });

        messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendMessage();
            }
        });

        function addMessage(role, content, meta = {}) {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            messageDiv.className = message ${role};
            
            let metaHtml = '';
            if (meta.type) {
                metaHtml = <div class="messagemeta">
                    ${role === 'assistant' ? '<span class="researchbadge">' + meta.type + '</span>' : ''}
                </div>;
            }
            
            let logHtml = '';
            if (meta.log && meta.log.length > 0) {
                logHtml = '<div class="researchlog">';
                meta.log.forEach(item => {
                    logHtml += <div class="research-log-item">${item}</div>;
                });
                logHtml += '</div>';
            }
            
            const formattedContent = role === 'assistant' && meta.type === 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' 
                ? formatReport(content) 
                : formatContent(content);
            
            messageDiv.innerHTML = 
                ${metaHtml}
                <div class="messagecontent ${meta.type === 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' ? 'reportsection' : ''}">${formattedContent}</div>
                ${logHtml}
            ;
            
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }

        function formatContent(content) {
            content = content.replace(/\\(.?)\\/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
            content = content.replace(/\(.?)\/g, '<em>$1</em>');
            content = content.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
            content = content.replace(/$$(\d+)$$/g, '<sup>[$1]</sup>');
            return content;
        }

        function formatReport(content) {
            content = content.replace(/^ (.?)$/gm, '<h1>$1</h1>');
            content = content.replace(/^ (.?)$/gm, '<h2>$1</h2>');
            content = content.replace(/^ (.?)$/gm, '<h3>$1</h3>');
            content = content.replace(/\\(.?)\\/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
            content = content.replace(/\(.?)\/g, '<em>$1</em>');
            content = content.replace(/\n\n/g, '<br><br>');
            content = content.replace(/$$(\d+)$$/g, '<sup>[$1]</sup>');
            return content;
        }

        function showLoading() {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const loadingDiv = document.createElement('div');
            loadingDiv.className = 'message assistant';
            loadingDiv.id = 'loading';
            loadingDiv.innerHTML = 
                <div class="messagecontent">
                    <div class="loading">
                        <span></span>
                        <span></span>
                        <span></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            ;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(loadingDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }

        function removeLoading() {
            const loading = document.getElementById('loading');
            if (loading) loading.remove();
        }

        function showResearchWidget() {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const widgetDiv = document.createElement('div');
            widgetDiv.className = 'message assistant';
            widgetDiv.id = 'researchwidget';
            widgetDiv.innerHTML = 
                <div class="researchwidget">
                    <div class="researchheader">
                        <div class="researchspinner"></div>
                        <div class="researchtitle">Mély kutatás folyamatban...</div>
                    </div>
                    <div id="researchphases"></div>
                    <div class="researchstats">
                        <div class="statitem">
                            <div class="statnumber" id="phasecount">0</div>
                            <div class="stattext">Fázis</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="statitem">
                            <div class="statnumber" id="sourcesfound">0</div>
                            <div class="stattext">Forrás</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="statitem">
                            <div class="statnumber" id="elapsedtime">0s</div>
                            <div class="stattext">Idő</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="progressbar">
                        <div class="progressfill" id="progressfill" style="width: 0%"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            ;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(widgetDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
            return widgetDiv;
        }

        function updateResearchWidget(phase, details, stats) {
            const phasesDiv = document.getElementById('researchphases');
            if (phasesDiv) {
                const phaseDiv = document.createElement('div');
                phaseDiv.className = 'researchphase';
                phaseDiv.innerHTML = 
                    <div class="phasename">${phase}</div>
                    <div class="phasedetail">${details}</div>
                ;
                phasesDiv.appendChild(phaseDiv);
                
                if (stats) {
                    if (stats.phaseCount) document.getElementById('phasecount').textContent = stats.phaseCount;
                    if (stats.sourcesFound) document.getElementById('sourcesfound').textContent = stats.sourcesFound;
                    if (stats.progress) document.getElementById('progressfill').style.width = stats.progress + '%';
                }
                
                document.getElementById('messages').scrollTop = document.getElementById('messages').scrollHeight;
            }
        }

        function removeResearchWidget() {
            const widget = document.getElementById('researchwidget');
            if (widget) widget.remove();
        }

        function updateSources(sources, count) {
            document.getElementById('sourceCount').textContent = count || sources.length;
            
            const sourcesList = document.getElementById('sourcesList');
            sourcesList.innerHTML = '';
            
            sources.slice(0, 5).forEach(source => {
                const sourceDiv = document.createElement('div');
                sourceDiv.className = 'sourceitem';
                sourceDiv.innerHTML = 
                    <div class="sourcetitle">${source.title || 'Cím nélküli'}</div>
                    <a href="${source.url}" target="_blank" class="sourceurl">${source.url}</a>
                ;
                sourcesList.appendChild(sourceDiv);
            });
        }

        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('messageInput');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            
            if (!message || isProcessing) return;
            
            addMessage('user', message);
            input.value = '';
            input.style.height = 'auto';
            isProcessing = true;
            document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
            
            showLoading();
            
            try {
                if (currentMode === 'research') {
                    removeLoading();
                    showResearchWidget();
                    
                    const startTime = Date.now();
                    const timeInterval = setInterval(() => {
                        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now()  startTime) / 1000);
                        const timeEl = document.getElementById('elapsedtime');
                        if (timeEl) timeEl.textContent = elapsed + 's';
                    }, 1000);
                    
                    updateResearchWidget('1. fázis', 'Lekérdezés elemzése és stratégia tervezés...', { phaseCount: 1, progress: 10 });
                    
                    const response = await fetch('/api/research', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'ContentType': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ query: message })
                    });
                    
                    const data = await response.json();
                    clearInterval(timeInterval);
                    
                    if (data.research_log) {
                        data.research_log.forEach((log, index) => {
                            const phase = Math.floor(index / 2) + 2;
                            const progress = Math.min(20 + (index  15), 95);
                            updateResearchWidget(${phase}. fázis, log, { 
                                phaseCount: phase,
                                sourcesFound: data.sources_count || 0,
                                progress: progress
                            });
                        });
                    }
                    
                    updateResearchWidget('Befejezés', 'Szintézis és jelentés generálás...', { 
                        progress: 100,
                        sourcesFound: data.sources_count || 0
                    });
                    
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        removeResearchWidget();
                        
                        if (data.error) {
                            addMessage('assistant', Hiba: ${data.error});
                        } else {
                            addMessage('assistant', data.answer, {
                                type: 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS',
                                log: data.research_log
                            });
                            
                            if (data.sources) {
                                updateSources(data.sources, data.sources_count);
                            }
                        }
                    }, 800);
                } else {
                    removeLoading();
                    
                    const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'ContentType': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ query: message })
                    });
                    
                    const reader = response.body.getReader();
                    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                    let fullResponse = '';
                    
                    const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    messageDiv.className = 'message assistant';
                    messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="messagecontent"></div>';
                    document.getElementById('messages').appendChild(messageDiv);
                    const contentDiv = messageDiv.querySelector('.messagecontent');
                    
                    while (true) {
                        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
                        if (done) break;
                        
                        const chunk = decoder.decode(value);
                        const lines = chunk.split('\n');
                        
                        for (const line of lines) {
                            if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
                                const data = line.slice(6);
                                if (data === '[DONE]') break;
                                
                                try {
                                    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
                                    if (parsed.content) {
                                        fullResponse += parsed.content;
                                        contentDiv.innerHTML = formatContent(fullResponse);
                                        document.getElementById('messages').scrollTop = document.getElementById('messages').scrollHeight;
                                    }
                                } catch (e) {}
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                removeLoading();
                addMessage('assistant', Hiba: ${error.message});
            }
            
            isProcessing = false;
            document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
        }

        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            navigator.serviceWorker.register('data:text/javascript,');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
